name: harden_terraform_s3_bucket
description: Harden an S3 bucket with versioning, a fully-locked public access block, and default encryption; broken leaves one public-access-block flag false
prompts: main.tf declares a bare aws_s3_bucket with no hardening at all. Add three sibling resources, all keyed off aws_s3_bucket.reports.id: an aws_s3_bucket_versioning resource with versioning_configuration.status = "Enabled"; an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block with ALL FOUR flags (block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, restrict_public_buckets) set to true - a partial lockdown is not a lockdown; and an aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration defaulting to AES256. Run `terraform fmt` on whatever you write. Do not modify the existing aws_s3_bucket resource.

test_setup_files.check_hardening.py:
import json
import re
import subprocess

fmt = subprocess.run(["terraform", "fmt", "-check", "-diff"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert fmt.returncode == 0, f"terraform fmt -check failed:\n{fmt.stdout}\n{fmt.stderr}"

init = subprocess.run(["terraform", "init", "-backend=false", "-input=false"],
                      capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
assert init.returncode == 0, f"terraform init failed:\n{init.stdout}\n{init.stderr}"

validate = subprocess.run(["terraform", "validate", "-no-color", "-json"],
                          capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(validate.stdout)
assert data.get("valid") is True, f"terraform validate failed: {validate.stdout}\n{validate.stderr}"

content = open("main.tf", encoding="utf-8").read()

assert re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_s3_bucket_versioning"', content), "no versioning resource"
assert re.search(r'status\s*=\s*"Enabled"', content), "versioning status must be Enabled"

pab = re.search(
    r'resource\s+"aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block"[^}]*\{([^}]*)\}', content, re.DOTALL)
assert pab, "no aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource"
block = pab.group(1)
for flag in ("block_public_acls", "block_public_policy", "ignore_public_acls",
            "restrict_public_buckets"):
    m = re.search(flag + r"\s*=\s*(true|false)", block)
    assert m, f"{flag} missing from the public access block"
    assert m.group(1) == "true", f"{flag} must be true, got {m.group(1)} - the bucket is not locked down"

assert re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration"', content), (
    "no default encryption configuration")

# the original bucket resource must survive untouched
assert re.search(r'resource\s+"aws_s3_bucket"\s+"reports"\s*\{', content), "bucket resource lost"

print("PASS terraform S3 hardening checks")
